sourceNotes.referenceTitle: old Dainty Bracelet Combo Set – Minimalist Ball Chain & Shimmering Twisted Link Duo
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your everyday style with this chic gold-toned bracelet duo. Combining a classic ball chain with a modern twisted link strand, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To maintain its radiant luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely in a dry place after every wear.
